deadline.value: Apply through the Zurich Graduate School in Mathematics (ZGSM) by 5 December 2026; the next round closes 5 April 2027. Bachelor's holders wanting the Direct Doctorate must apply 1-30 November 2026.
deadline.quote: There are two application periods with deadline April 05 and December 05. | Next deadline: December 05, 2026

supervisor.value: You apply to ZGSM (you may name preferred advisors); after an assessment talk and interview, successful applicants are offered a position with a designated advisor.
supervisor.quote: Please indicate on the online application form the name(s) of preferred advisors.

also.quote: In case of a successful assessment applicants will be offered a doctoral position with a designated advisor.

funding.value: Admitted students are typically offered a teaching assistantship whose salary is sufficient to live in Zurich.
funding.quote: Students who get admitted to the ZGSM are typically offered a teaching assistantship. | In any case the salary is largely sufficient to live and study in Zurich.

entry_route.value: ZGSM expects a Master's in mathematics; exceptional Bachelor's graduates can instead apply for the Direct Doctorate in Mathematics with a future supervisor's funding confirmation.
entry_route.quote: Applicants are expected to have a master degree in mathematics.

also.quote: Direct Doctorate (applications in the first application window only) | For a successful application, a confirmation of the future supervisor (ETH professor) is required.
Mathematical Physics, Number Theory, Numerical Analysis, Operation Research, Probability Theory, Scientifc Computing, Statistics

notes: ZGSM is the joint doctoral program of D-MATH (ETH) and I-MATH (UZH); its research areas include Statistics (ETH Seminar for Statistics). 10-20 positions for international students per year. German for teaching tutorials is expected within two years.
name: Zurich Graduate School in Mathematics (ZGSM)
